reply_text:
I replied to Hollis in a thread on his #central-team message. I said the next Tansleigh Packaging renewal (the Wicklow work) is on 8 June, as he told us.

I didn't save the date anywhere else. I don't keep notes from one conversation to the next, and I couldn't find any Tansleigh account files in the share, so I had nothing to check the date against or update. His message and my reply are the only record for now. To keep it longer, someone would need to add it to the account's CRM or profile file.

A renewal date is an account detail, not a money figure, so it was fine to discuss in the channel. I didn't need anyone's approval.
